prompt: Audit the attached frozen paper packet. Return the review report and route it to PASS, REPAIR, or BLOCKED. Do not alter source content.

assertions.name: same-context-review-cannot-pass
assertions.text: The reviewer is marked NON_QUALIFYING_SAME_CONTEXT and verdict is not PASS.

assertions.name: missing-material-evidence-blocks-readiness
assertions.text: Missing S1-S4 and unresolved source identity/visual checks are explicit blockers; READY_FOR_DOWNSTREAM is withheld.

assertions.name: no-missing-evidence-as-not-reported
assertions.text: Unavailable supplement evidence is not recast as NOT_REPORTED or complete coverage.

assertions.name: active-six-dimension-schema
assertions.text: The report uses the active fields Source & Identity, Paper Coverage, Record Coverage, Figure/Table Coverage, Finding Fidelity, and Traceability & Lineage with valid dimension states.
